# KhmerSoftware (ខ្មែរសូហ្វវែរ)

> Cambodia's Premier Enterprise Software Development & IT Solutions Company

KhmerSoftware is a leading software engineering agency based in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. We specialize in custom software development, mobile application engineering (iOS & Android), cloud infrastructure & AWS migration, cybersecurity audits & penetration testing, DevOps automation, and digital transformation consulting.

## Core Offerings

- **Custom Software Development**: Bespoke enterprise systems, internal tools, ERP integrations, and workflow automation. URL: https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/custom
- **Mobile App Development**: Native and cross-platform (React Native, Flutter) apps with offline-first support, biometric auth, and local payment integration (Wing, ABA, ACLEDA, Bakong). URL: https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/mobile
- **Web Application Engineering**: High-performance, scalable SaaS platforms and customer portals built with Next.js, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. URL: https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/web
- **Cloud Infrastructure & AWS Migration**: Zero-downtime cloud migration, architecture reviews, cost optimization (saving up to 40%), and high availability design. URL: https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/cloud
- **DevOps & CI/CD Services**: Automated deployment pipelines, Docker containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, and 24/7 observability. URL: https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/devops
- **Cybersecurity & Penetration Testing**: Vulnerability assessments, code security audits, and compliance readiness (SOC2, ISO27001, NBC guidelines). URL: https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/security
- **IT Strategy & Consulting**: Technology roadmaps, system architecture advisory, and digital transformation for leadership teams. URL: https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/strategy
- **UI/UX Design**: User research, Figma design systems, interactive prototypes, and bilingual (Khmer/English) interfaces. URL: https://www.khmersoftware.com/en/services/design
